items.title: Extract shared firing leaf core/experience-hint-surface.ts + refactor story-review.ts to use it (behavior-preserving)
items.context: Create leaf packages/main/src/core/experience-hint-surface.ts exporting surfaceExperienceHints(root, { storyId, hintRoundKey }): { hintMode, renderedSection, hintIds, fired }. Body MUST mirror the current story-review.ts firing block (~lines 610-649) EXACTLY: hintMode=resolveHintMode(storyId); load via loadExperienceHints(root)+formatExperienceHintsSection; if hasExperienceHints, dedup-scan readActivityLogTail(root,1000) for event==='experience_hint_surfaced' && storyId && reviewRound===hintRoundKey; on miss appendActivityLog({timestamp,event:'experience_hint_surfaced',storyId,reviewRound:hintRoundKey,hintMode,hintIds:experienceHintIds(hints)}) — fires on BOTH arms (fired=true only when it appended); renderedSection = hintMode==='on' ? formatExperienceHintsSection(hints) : ''. Wrap load/track in try/catch returning renderedSection='' on failure (keep the existing console.warn-on-failure semantics if present). CRITICAL: the CALLER supplies hintRoundKey — the leaf never computes the `currentReviewRound || plan:<phase>` formula. Imports ONLY ../core/experience-hint-loader.js, ../core/hint-mode.js, ../core/activity-log.js (already core leaves; zero new cross-layer edges). Then refactor handlers/story-review.ts to call surfaceExperienceHints(ctx.root,{storyId:args.storyId,hintRoundKey}) (hintRoundKey still computed at ~line 603 in the handler) and source renderedHintsSection from it; _reviewPrompt assembly otherwise unchanged. Behavior MUST be byte-identical (same _reviewPrompt bytes, same event payload, same dedup) on BOTH arms.
items.userSees: A new leaf core/experience-hint-surface.ts exists with a single surfaceExperienceHints implementation; story_review still produces byte-identical _reviewPrompt and experience_hint_surfaced events on both arms (proven by a golden assertion). node packages/main/dist/tasks/<smoke>.js and full npm test exit 0.

items.title: Wire surfaceExperienceHints into buildNextSteps REVIEW branch (transition-effects.ts) so hints surface in the reviewer-launch text + fire the A/B event
items.context: In packages/main/src/handlers/transition-effects.ts, in the REVIEW branch of buildNextSteps, AFTER the round-2 advisory block (after ~line 286, before `return base`), add an append-only try/catch block: const story = store.readStory(storyId); const hintRoundKey = story.currentReviewRound || `plan:${story.phase}` (BYTE-IDENTICAL formula to story-review.ts ~line 603); const { renderedSection } = surfaceExperienceHints(root, { storyId, hintRoundKey }); if (renderedSection) base += `\n${renderedSection}`. The leaf fires experience_hint_surfaced on BOTH arms; only the ON-arm renderedSection is non-empty, so the OFF arm appends NOTHING (byte-identical to today). Place the block AFTER the Agent({lattice-review-*}) launch lines so the hints physically follow the reviewer-launch text the agent reads. Wrap the WHOLE block in try { } catch { /* advisory-only: never block the transition */ } (same safety posture as the existing round-2 advisory). Add import { surfaceExperienceHints } from '../core/experience-hint-surface.js'. Add a code comment documenting: ADVISORY-ONLY (never fed to resolveReviewPromptHash, no gate reads it); OFF arm appends nothing → byte-identical; cross-site dedup with story_review via shared hintRoundKey; ordering dependency on transition-orchestrator persisting currentReviewRound BEFORE buildNextSteps.
items.userSees: After story_advance --phase=REVIEW on an ON-arm story that has finding-signals, the reviewer-launch guidance text now contains the rendered "Project experience hints (advisory only)" section right after the Agent({lattice-review-*}) lines, and exactly one experience_hint_surfaced event (hintMode:on) is recorded for that review round. On an OFF-arm story the guidance text is byte-identical to today and exactly one event (hintMode:off) is recorded. The transition never fails due to hint surfacing.

items.title: Smoke: ON renders + OFF byte-identical + lossless events + cross-site dedup + resolveReviewPromptHash invariant
items.context: Add packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-review-dispatch-hint-smoke.ts (auto-discovered by run-all-smokes.ts; mirror experience-layer-ab-shadow-gate-smoke.ts structure) asserting: (a) ON-arm story (storyId whose sha256 first byte is even) WITH finding-signals → buildNextSteps REVIEW text CONTAINS the rendered hints section AND exactly one experience_hint_surfaced event with hintMode:'on' + full hintIds; (b) OFF-arm story → REVIEW text BYTE-IDENTICAL to the no-hints baseline (no rendered section) AND exactly one event hintMode:'off' carrying full hintIds (lossless measurement); (c) CROSS-SITE DEDUP: run story_review (PLAN, plan:<phase> event) then advance to REVIEW + buildNextSteps for the SAME story → assert the REVIEW round fires its OWN single event under the ISO currentReviewRound key (disjoint from plan:<phase>), and re-running buildNextSteps in the same REVIEW round adds NO second event; assert the REVIEW event.reviewRound equals the ISO currentReviewRound (NOT plan:<phase>) — guards the ordering dependency; (d) INVARIANT: capture resolveReviewPromptHash / review-run output for an ON vs OFF story (same inputs except arm) and assert BYTE-IDENTICAL. Add a golden assertion (here or extend experience-layer-ab-shadow-gate-smoke.ts) that story-review.ts _reviewPrompt bytes + event payload are byte-unchanged before/after the leaf extraction. Add package.json script alias test:experience-layer-review-dispatch-hint. Build (tsc) + run full smoke suite + lifecycle-registry-contract (must stay green WITHOUT edits — no new command).
items.userSees: node packages/main/dist/tasks/experience-layer-review-dispatch-hint-smoke.js prints its checks and exits 0; full npm test exits 0 with the new smoke auto-discovered in the chain; lifecycle-registry-contract stays green (no command-policy/process-fact drift).
